items.title: Madras High Court refuses bail to extortion accused over controversial Instagram post
items.summary: The Madras High Court recently upheld a trial court's decision to cancel the bail granted to an extortion accused after taking note of Instagram posts in which he was glorified as a "King" and shown brandishing a weapon-like object [ Janny Vs State ]. Justice N Ramesh explained that such conduct created a real possibility of witnesses being intimidated. " Within months of his release (on bail) he is publicly projected, on pages bearing his name and followed by thousands, as the 'king' of Vellore, with a weapon in hand. That projection has a direct bearing on whether the witnesses who remain to be examined will come forward and depose freely," the Court said. It proceeded to hold that such conduct is sufficient to cancel the accused person's bail. "It is precisely the kind of circumstance which renders continued liberty no longer conducive to a fair trial. The likelihood of the witnesses being overawed is real, and not a matter of speculation ... I am satisfied that the petitioner has misused the liberty granted to him, and that his continued liberty is not conducive to a fair trial, " the Court held. Justice N Ramesh The Court made the observation while dealing with a plea by Janny
